name: Vacuum Sealer Hand Machine ZKFK-001 | Automatic Food Sealer with 5 Vacuum Bags for Fresh Food Storage
description:
The Vacuum Sealer Hand Machine ZKFK-001 is a powerful, portable food preservation tool designed to keep food fresh up to 5× longer by removing air and sealing in flavor. Featuring strong suction, dual wet & dry sealing modes, and simple one-button operation, it ensures airtight packaging for meat, vegetables, snacks, and meal prep. Compact and lightweight, it is perfect for home kitchens, travel, camping, and organized food storage. With included reusable vacuum bags, this sealer helps reduce waste and extend the shelf life of your groceries.Key Features:
 Automatic vacuum sealing with powerful suction
 Dual wet & dry sealing modes for versatile use
 Includes 5 reusable vacuum bags
 Red & green LED indicators for sealing status
 Compact, lightweight, and travel-friendly design
 Preserves food 5× longer by removing air effectively
 Enhances flavor retention and prevents freezer burnHow to Use:
1⃣ Place food inside a vacuum bag; flatten and remove dust or wrinkles
2⃣ Insert the open end of the bag into the vacuum chamber under the air inlet
3⃣ Press the top cover firmly, then lock both sides
4⃣ Select wet or dry mode depending on food type
5⃣ Press the vacuum seal button; LED turns red during sealing
6⃣ When LED turns green, sealing is complete
7⃣ Press left and right locks to open the lid and remove sealed foodIngredients / Materials:
ABS plastic body, electronic motor, silicone sealing stripSafety Information:
 Do not touch the hot sealing strip immediately after use
 Keep device dry; avoid contact with water
 Do not use for sealing liquids without proper support
 Unplug after use and keep away from children

Package Includes:
 1 × Vacuum Sealer Hand Machine ZKFK-001
 5 × Reusable Vacuum Storage Bags
